n = int(input())
k = int(input())

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def add(x):
    return x - MOD if x >= MOD else x

def sub(x):
    return x + MOD if x < 0 else x

def mul(x, y):
    return (x * y) % MOD

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.n = size
        self.a = [[0] * (size + 1) for _ in range(size + 1)]
    def init(self):
        for i in range(1, self.n + 1):
            for j in range(1, self.n + 1):
                self.a[i][j] = 0
    def set(self):
        self.init()
        for i in range(1, self.n + 1):
            self.a[i][i] = 1
    def __mul__(self, rhs):
        ans = Matrix(self.n)
        tmp = [[0] * (self.n + 1) for _ in range(self.n + 1)]
        MODLL = MOD * MOD
        for i in range(1, self.n + 1):
            for j in range(1, self.n + 1):
                tmp[i][j] = 0
        for i in range(1, self.n + 1):
            for k in range(1, self.n + 1):
                for j in range(1, self.n + 1):
                    tmp[i][j] += self.a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j]
                    if tmp[i][j] >= MODLL:
                        tmp[i][j] -= MODLL
        for i in range(1, self.n + 1):
            for j in range(1, self.n + 1):
                ans.a[i][j] = tmp[i][j] % MOD
        return ans

def main():
    n_value = n
    k_value = k
    num = []
    cnt = 0
    while n_value:
        cnt += 1
        num.append(n_value % k_value)
        n_value //= k_value

    k = k_value
    # Initialize matrices
    f = [[Matrix(k + 1) for _ in range(k)] for _ in range(cnt)]
    sump = [[Matrix(k + 1) for _ in range(k)] for _ in range(cnt)]
    sums = [[Matrix(k + 1) for _ in range(k)] for _ in range(cnt)]

    for i in range(k):
        f[0][i] = Matrix(k + 1)
        f[0][i].set()
        for j in range(1, k + 2):
            f[0][i].a[j][j] = 1
            f[0][i].a[i + 1][j] = 1

    # Initialize prefix sums
    sump[0][0] = f[0][0]
    sums[0][k - 1] = f[0][k - 1]

    for i in range(1, k):
        sump[0][i] = f[0][i] * sump[0][i - 1]
    for i in range(k - 2, -1, -1):
        sums[0][i] = sums[0][i + 1] * f[0][i]

    for i in range(1, cnt):
        for j in range(k):
            if j == 0:
                f[i][j] = sums[i - 1][j]
            else:
                f[i][j] = sump[i - 1][j - 1] * sums[i - 1][j]
        sump[i][0] = f[i][0]
        sums[i][k - 1] = f[i][k - 1]
        for j in range(1, k):
            sump[i][j] = f[i][j] * sump[i][j - 1]
        for j in range(k - 2, -1, -1):
            sums[i][j] = sums[i][j + 1] * f[i][j]

    ans = Matrix(k + 1)
    ans.set()

    sum_idx = 0
    for i in range(cnt - 1, -1, -1):
        for j in range(num[i]):
            ans = f[i][(sum_idx + j) % k] * ans
        sum_idx += num[i]
        sum_idx %= k

    res = 0
    for i in range(1, k + 2):
        res = add(res + ans.a[i][k + 1])

    print(res)

main()
